reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value (bar.toCharArray()) depends on user input (param). While doSomething modifies the last character of param to 'Z', the remaining string content is still derived directly from the user-provided param. This partial sanitization does not prevent XSS attacks targeting other parts of the string. Case TP: at least one alert is alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input flows from getQueryString to param, passed to doSomething, assigned to bar, and printed to response writer
